summary.text: Lanny Thomas is a Republican state senator from Georgia's District 53, who took office on April 23, 2026, after winning a special election runoff on April 7, 2026, and is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026. He is a longtime educator and a former mayor of Trion.

paragraphs.text: Lanny Thomas graduated from Lafayette High School in 1980, earned a bachelor's degree in education from West Georgia College, and later earned a master's degree and an education specialist degree from Jacksonville State University.
His career experience includes teaching at Pennville Elementary, LaFayette High School and Trion City Schools.

He has also served as mayor of Trion, a Trion city council member and a deacon, and has been affiliated with Lookout Mountain CASA, the Summerville/Trion Optimist Club and Georgia Municipal Association District One.
Thomas ran for the District 53 Senate seat in 2016, losing the Republican primary to incumbent Jeff Mullis, 66.6 percent to 33.4 percent.
In 2026 he succeeded Colton Moore in the seat, and he defeated Denise Burns and Blake Elsberry in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary with 72.5 percent of the vote.
